chunks.text: Airspace is air-traffic control for coding agents.

chunks.text: The agents live on the same graph. What each one claims, and every caller and test two hops out, is its airspace.
Every edit is checked against the graph before it is written.
If it would break another agent's work, it is held, and the agent is told why.
The decision is a Cypher query, not a model call.
